diagnosis: The check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden information in PF1 (the 42 mL/hr rate and gravity restriction), passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker only having access to public facts S1-S4. The model correctly assigned the pump to North based on general medical logic or standard release processes, but failed to incorporate the specific required value of 42 mL/hr, showing that C1 is satisfiable through generic assignment without the hidden infusion rate.

C1.why: The exact 42 mL-per-hour continuous infusion and the fact that North cannot use gravity change the pump assignment to North and set the pump rate to exactly 42.
